name: Photo Synth (VST3)
description: A synthesiser you play by moving a cursor across a photograph. The colours under the cursor are the sound — hue, saturation and brightness map onto the oscillator, the filter and the effects, so a picture is a patch and moving across it is a performance. Load your own photos; a recorded cursor path becomes a phrase that plays itself. Four pads, a seven-module effects chain, and SPECTRA characters that reshape how every voice is built.
note: Windows VST3 · build 260830.1 · free download · manual and developer kit included.
